newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-YANKEES' STRAWBERRY DECIDES TO HAVE KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-YANKEES' STRAWBERRY DECIDES TO HAVE KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: New York Yankees slugger Darryl Strawberry, who has been on the disabled list for more than two months, has decided to have exploratory arthroscopic surgery on his left knee.
The surgery will be performed sometime next week, the team announced Friday.
The 35-year-old Strawberry played with a noticeable limp while going 4-for-15 with two homers and six RBI during a four-game rehabilitation stint with Triple-A Columbus last week.
He has been on the disabled list since April 11 due to fluid on his left knee after going hitless in 14 at-bats with the Yankees.
An earlier rehab assignment with Double-A Norwich also had to be cut short after one game when he was diagnosed with irritated cartilage under his left kneecap.
Strawberry batted .262 with 11 homers and 36 RBI in 63 games last season.
